'''Len Trana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Dread War]], she was stationed on [[Oricon]] specializing as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] for fellow [[Republic trooper]]s.
